//maintainers: Who can merge, once the repo is shared (the skill's "Several people"): each by "id:<id>", the viewer id the hosted review page sends (`reel record` prints it: "by owner (id:…)"), or an email (git's user.email, for a review sent from the local page). "owner" still matches, with a warning: it is whoever published the page, so on a page of their own a second person is "owner" too. A walkthrough review by anyone else is a contributor's own check: its verdicts add nothing to the decision log. Empty: one person, every review counts.
//pr: What `reel pr-check` asks of every pull request. "issue": "required" fails a PR whose text links no issue ("Closes #12", "Refs #12", "owner/repo#12" or an issues URL); "off", the default, leaves it to the repo.
//narration: Which engine narrates the videos. Without a "narration" key: HyperFrames' own, local Kokoro + whisper (the default). A hosted one is much faster on a small machine: REELPLANNER_TTS=openrouter and OPENROUTER_API_KEY in ~/.reelplanner/.env (every repo on the machine), or "narration": { "tts": "openrouter" } here with the key in the git-ignored .env beside this file, never here (not Kokoro over an API: it is slower than local) (reelplanner's docs/reference.md, "Narration engines"; `reelplanner setup --dry-run` says which is used).

agent.//: Started headless when a review is sent from the local page and no session is waiting, with the prompt appended: keep -p last. D-082: auto mode (a classifier approves each action, subagents and the web included; anything that would still ask is refused) inside Claude Code's sandbox (shell commands write only inside the repo and reach only hosts the classifier approves; no unsandboxed retry; a plain `git commit` runs outside it, so signing works). The file tools are not in the sandbox, so the PreToolUse hook refuses a Write, Edit or NotebookEdit to any path outside the repo (a permission rule cannot: deny beats allow, so denying everything would deny the repo too). The sandbox needs macOS, or Linux with bubblewrap and socat; not native Windows or a root container: there the review server runs the command with the sandbox off and says so (shell commands are then not fenced to the repo; the hook still fences the file tools). This is Claude Code's, the tested one; `reel init --agent codex` writes Codex's instead and `--agent none` none (reelplanner's docs/agents.md says what each is tested for); opencode "opencode run --auto" with "permission" rules in opencode.json (no OS sandbox) is untested. Empty: reviews wait in .reelplanner/inbox/ for the next session.
agent.command: claude --permission-mode auto --permission-prompts none --settings '{"sandbox":{"enabled":true,"failIfUnavailable":true,"allowUnsandboxedCommands":false,"excludedCommands":["git commit *"]},"hooks":{"PreToolUse":[{"matcher":"Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit","hooks":[{"type":"command","command":"node","args":["-e","const p=require(`path`),fs=require(`fs`);let s=``;process.stdin.on(`data`,d=>s+=d).on(`end`,()=>{let root,file;try{const j=JSON.parse(s),t=j.tool_input||{},f=t.file_path||t.notebook_path;if(!f)return;const real=x=>{let r=p.resolve(x),tail=[];while(true){try{return p.join(fs.realpathSync(r),...tail)}catch{if(p.dirname(r)===r)return p.resolve(x);tail.unshift(p.basename(r));r=p.dirname(r)}}};root=real(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||j.cwd);file=real(p.resolve(j.cwd||root,f))}catch(e){console.error(`Refused: could not read the tool call (`+e.message+`)`);process.exit(2)}const rel=p.relative(root,file);if(rel===`..`||rel.startsWith(`..`+p.sep)||p.isAbsolute(rel)){console.error(`Refused: `+file+` is outside the repo (`+root+`). This run writes files only inside the repo.`);process.exit(2)}})"]}]}]}}' -p
